Measure a sticker or picture-in-picture media layout box without creating a VE
editor or Effect render instance.

AGENT QUICKSTART (driving this as an agent? start here):
  Browse commands:  lyra-cli <domain> --help

USAGE:
  lyra-cli <domain> <[subdomain] ...> <action> [--flags] [--options]


OPTIONS:
  -h,     --help              Print this help message and exit
          --input TEXT REQUIRED 
                              Resource path or URI: local path, local:///<abs_path>, or
                              vimo://<resource_id>.
          --type, --element-type TEXT:{sticker,image,photo,video,text-template,text_template,music,sound,audio} [sticker]  
                              Material layout semantics: sticker, image/photo, video,
                              text-template, music/sound/audio.
          --resource-dir TEXT Download directory for vimo:// input. Ignored for local input.
          --canvas-width FLOAT:POSITIVE REQUIRED 
                              Canvas width in pixels.
          --canvas-height FLOAT:POSITIVE REQUIRED 
                              Canvas height in pixels.
          --longest-edge INT:NONNEGATIVE 
                              Sticker-only maximum resource edge in pixels. Default: canvas
                              short edge.
          --clip-scale FLOAT:NONNEGATIVE 
                              Final VE clip scale. Default: Effect recommendation for stickers,
                              1 for image/video.
          --scale-x FLOAT:POSITIVE [1.000000]  
                              Additional horizontal layout scale. Default 1.
          --scale-y FLOAT:POSITIVE [1.000000]  
                              Additional vertical layout scale. Default 1.
          --rotation FLOAT    Clockwise rotation in degrees. Used to calculate the axis-aligned
                              box.
          --center FLOAT x 2  Element center X Y in canvas pixels. Default: canvas center.
          --crop FLOAT x 4    Image/video-only normalized crop rectangle: left top right
                              bottom.
          --allow-video-decode 
                              Allow an MP4 sticker to decode its first frame. Ordinary video
                              measurement uses metadata only.
          --layout-json TEXT  Typed Blueprint-style relative layout JSON object. Supports
                              positive scale, width, height, offset_x, offset_y, rotation,
                              horizontal_anchor, and vertical_anchor. scale cannot coexist with
                              width or height.
          --text, --content TEXT [measure]  
                              Text content used when measuring a text_template resource.
  -v,     --version           Show version information and exit.
          --jq TEXT           Pretty-print JSON output; with an optional selector like
                              .result.items[0].id, output the selected JSON value instead of
                              the full schema envelope.

EXAMPLES
  # Measure a local sticker package on a 9:16 canvas
  $ lyra-cli media measure-box --input /tmp/sticker --type sticker --canvas-width 1080 --canvas-height 1920
  # Measure a remote Vimo sticker; download is internal to this command
  $ lyra-cli media measure-box --input vimo://<resource_id> --type sticker --canvas-width 1080 --canvas-height 1920
  # Measure a local GIF sticker with rotation and explicit center
  $ lyra-cli media measure-box --input /tmp/a.gif --type sticker --canvas-width 1080 --canvas-height 1920 --rotation 30 --center 300 500
  # Measure a local image as picture-in-picture media
  $ lyra-cli media measure-box --type image --input /tmp/photo.jpg --canvas-width 1080 --canvas-height 1920 --clip-scale 0.333
  # Measure a local video as picture-in-picture media
  $ lyra-cli media measure-box --type video --input /tmp/a.mp4 --canvas-width 1080 --canvas-height 1920
  # Use the same relative layout spec as Blueprint static layout
  $ lyra-cli media measure-box --type image --input /tmp/photo.jpg --canvas-width 1080 --canvas-height 1920 --layout-json '{"width":0.2,"height":0.12,"horizontal_anchor":"center","vertical_anchor":"center"}'
  # Scale and anchor without an explicit width or height
  $ lyra-cli media measure-box --type image --input /tmp/photo.jpg --canvas-width 1080 --canvas-height 1920 --layout-json '{"scale":1.5,"horizontal_anchor":"end","vertical_anchor":"center"}'
